active.description: Only list prompts that are on (true) or off (false). Omit to list both.

branded.description: Only list prompts whose current text names the brand (true) or does not (false). Omit to list both. A prompt is branded when its text names the brand: the registrable name of a target domain as a word, case ignored, so 'example' and 'example.com' both name example.com. Branded prompts almost always get answers that mention the brand.

date_from.description: First day of the window. Takes a date such as '2026-11-01' or a relative day such as '-30d' (30 days ago), '-2w', 'mStart' (first day of this month) or 'yStart'. Days are whole days in the project's timezone. Default '-30d'. The window from date_from to date_to can cover at most 91 days.

date_to.description: Last day of the window, included. Takes a date such as '2026-11-01' or a relative day such as '-30d' (30 days ago), '-2w', 'mStart' (first day of this month) or 'yStart'. Days are whole days in the project's timezone. Default today. A later day is read as today.

engine.description: With needs_improvement, only read the answers of this engine, for example 'claude-web-search'. Ignored unless needs_improvement is true.

include_archived.description: Also list archived prompts. Archived prompts are left out by default.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

needs_improvement.description: Only list prompts that the engines answered from date_from to date_to without citing a target domain. Prompts with no answered check in that window are left out.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

topic.description: Only list prompts with this topic. An empty value lists the prompts that have no topic.
